Rust + WebAssembly Performance: Pure JS vs. wasm-bindgen vs. Raw WASM with SIMD
When writing code for the web, JavaScript is the default choice: lightweight, interpreted, and heavily optimized by modern engines such as V8 (Chrome, Node.js) and SpiderMonkey (Firefox).
